blocks.body: Replace a product string in a scoped folder without touching the library warning or the booklet’s stored name by accident.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Folder first
blocks.body:
Find in Files is an audit. Replace is a sharp tool. Set **folder**, **file filter**, and if you have it, **preview**.

Never Replace All on the whole workspace. Never replace a tag name as if it were English.

If the string is the product name, the repair is a **keyref** (a name pointer), not a replace that also hits the booklet’s stored name.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Scope** :  the folder and file type you search in, so you do not change the whole workspace.

blocks.title: Interactive Tutorials in Oxygen
watchFor: Where Find/Replace in Files lives if shown

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Replace All ran on the whole workspace, or the booklet’s stored name was emptied, or warnings.dita lost a sentence you did not intend.

Expected: Replace log written. The booklet still holds the product name. Completeness clean. No workspace-wide replace.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Find in Files: KP-2a (or your product string) across the kitepump folder. Count the hits. Note which are the stored name in the booklet, which are pointers, and which are leftover typed text.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: If topics still have a typed product string, replace them in topics/ only :  not in maps/, not in ditaval/, not in warnings.dita unless you mean to.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Use Find/Replace in Files with a file filter (*.dita) and a folder scope. Preview replacements if your version has Preview. Do not Replace All on the whole workspace.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: After replace: confirm open files have no red error, then run completeness on the root map.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week5/replace-log.txt: scope, filter, how many replacements, what you left untouched.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: If the booklet’s stored name changed by accident, undo, then write that you needed undo.

blocks.summary: Replace log written. The booklet still holds the product name. Completeness clean. No workspace-wide replace.

blocks.q: Replace All on the whole workspace for note → caution. What blows up?
options: Tag names, comments, and unmatched sentences
blocks.why: You will rename tags. Folder plus file filter exist because of this class of mistake.

blocks.q: The product name lives in the booklet. A page still has a typed copy. First repair?
options: Replace the page copy with a name pointer; leave the booklet as the source
Delete the name in the booklet so there is one copy on the page
blocks.why: The booklet owns the name. Replace on pages is toward a key, not toward deleting the key.
